thread:
tess: FYI finance ops raised a stuck marketplace PO: PO# 555991122. Customer charged but our ledger shows PENDING and vendor lookup failed on accept. tagging marketplace ops + eng.

aron: cc @kevin. noticed this pattern when sellers are cross-listed and our vendor mapping TTL evicts just before accept window closes.

kevin: pulling logs now. initial accept shows marketplace returned 404 vendor_not_registered. our payload had vendor_id:null.

azure-support: automated reply: case AZ-99199 opened. please provide accept payload and receipt timestamps.

liz-legal: separate note: the seller on the cross-list has different signed signatories across marketplaces. if we attach ledger manually we need an attestation PDF or MSA amendment.

finance-bot: alert: PO 555991122 -> PENDING_LEDGER_SYNC. hold reason: vendor_lookup_failed.

kevin: log snippet:
```
{"event":"marketplace_ack","po":"555991122","vendor_uuid":null,"response":{"status":404,"error":"vendor_not_registered"}}
```

aron: mitigation options: 1) short-term manual ledger attach with legal attestation; 2) long-term: increase cache TTL for cross-listed sellers and add a retry reconciliation worker for PENDING_LEDGER_SYNC POs.

tess: can we do manual attach to unblock revenue? finance says yes if legal approves.

liz-legal: I can accept a signed attestation scanned PDF as a one-off. partnerships needs to request this from seller.

kevin: one-off command to attach ledger: `./bin/ledger_attach --po 555991122 --vendor-uuid <resolved-uuid>` I'll run after legal confirms. also will add op note to tag `crosslist-ttl` when seeing vendor_lookup_failed.

aron: i'll draft the TTL bump + recon worker PR. small config change and new worker. estimate 48h to test + deploy (canary first).

tess: who will contact the seller for attestation?

aron: i'll own the outreach and include the attestation template. ETA 3h. will loop in azure-support if we need proof of vendor agreement.

azure-support: noted. updated case AZ-99199 with logs and expected manual attach plan.

finance-bot: please annotate PO 555991122 with reason code `manual_attach_pending_attestation`.

liz-legal: once seller returns the scanned attestation, send to me and I'll approve.

kevin: ops playbook update: if you see `vendor_lookup_failed` + cross-list flag, tag ticket `crosslist-ledger-stall` and escalate to eng-oncall.

tess: summary: 1) @aron outreach + attestation template (3h) 2) @liz-legal review attestation 3) @kevin run ledger_attach after legal sign-off 4) @aron PR for TTL + recon worker (48h) 5) @tess confirm finance revenue treatment post-attach. will update thread when attestation lands. :white_check_mark:
